UnitStatement: A semantic-lensing brief requires `ScopePath` as the run or context anchor, normally the deliverable folder.
A semantic-lensing brief requires `TaskSkill` set to `semantic-lensing`.
A semantic-lensing brief requires `RuntimeOverrides.DELIVERABLE_PATH` as the absolute path to the deliverable folder.
`UseSemanticLensing` defaults to `true` and is accepted as a compatibility flag by existing dispatchers.
`ActiveMatrices` defaults to all matrices and may restrict processing to comma-separated matrix letters.
`FocusLensTags` defaults to all tags and may restrict processing to specific `Matrix.Row.Column` tags.
`ApplyEdits` defaults to `false` and controls whether authorized writes are applied.
`AllowLensLogUpdate` defaults to `false` and permits `_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md` creation or update only with write authorization.
`AllowTransferableContextUpdate` defaults to `false` and permits `_TRANSFERABLE_CONTEXT.md` creation or update only with write authorization.
If `AllowLensLogUpdate` or `AllowTransferableContextUpdate` is true, the brief must set `ApplyEdits: true` and authorize the target files.
Every semantic-lensing proposal must include a `Lens: <Matrix.Row.Column>` tag.
Lens tags are valid only when their matrix letter exists in `_SEMANTIC.md`.
Proposals must cite production documents or accessible sources as evidence rather than lensing entries.
Unsupported content must be marked `TBD` rather than fabricated.
Contradictions between lensing entries and source material must be reported in `NEEDS_HUMAN_RULING`.
When `ActiveMatrices` is specified, processing must stay within the selected matrices.
`_SEMANTIC.md` must remain unmodified during semantic-lensing work.
If `_SEMANTIC.md` is missing, report `MISSING` because the skill cannot operate without it.
If `_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md` is missing when enrichment processing is expected, report `MISSING` and fall back to initial lens analysis only.
If no meaningful lens findings exist, state that explicitly rather than padding output.
Each incorporated lensing entry must trace to a source or production document location.
A lensing entry row is a worklist pointer, not evidence.
Processed lensing entries must record whether they were incorporated, converted to TBD, or discarded.
semantic-lensing applies analysis to deliverable-local production documents.
`_SEMANTIC.md` serves as the lens reference for semantic-lensing analysis.
`_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md` serves as the enrichment worklist for semantic-lensing analysis.
The semantic-lensing skill supplies matrix interpretation, tagging conventions, and proposal workflow.
semantic-lensing is an optional interactive proposal and review tool, not the regular ORCHESTRATOR enrichment step.
In the regular setup workflow, `skills/lens-register/` produces `_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md`.
In the regular setup workflow, `skills/four-documents/` Pass 3 consumes `_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md` as an enrichment worklist.
`skills/semantic-lensing/` is loaded when a WORKING_ITEMS or TASK run needs human-facing proposals, focused review, or optional lens artifact updates.
`_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md` becomes useful to the four documents through `four-documents` Pass 3.
The semantic-lensing skill may consume `_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md` only for interactive review.
Both semantic-lensing paths treat lensing entries as candidates rather than evidence.
semantic-lensing is the interactive proposal-producing contract in its family.
`skills/lens-register/` is the setup-time counterpart that generates the matrix-organized register.
The semantic-lensing skill is suitable for the TASK generic shell.
`ScopePath` is a required input for semantic-lensing.
`RuntimeOverrides.DELIVERABLE_PATH` is a required input for semantic-lensing.
`_SEMANTIC.md` must exist in the deliverable folder and is read-only.
`_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md` is an optional enrichment worklist; if absent, the skill generates initial lens analysis only.
`ActiveMatrices` restricts analysis to named matrices and defaults to all matrices found in `_SEMANTIC.md`.
`FocusLensTags` restricts processing to specific `Matrix.Row.Column` tags.
`AllowLensLogUpdate` permits creating or updating `_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md`.
`AllowTransferableContextUpdate` permits creating or updating `_TRANSFERABLE_CONTEXT.md`.
The `UseSemanticLensing` flag is compatibility-only; loading `semantic-lensing` selects the method.
`LensDepth` can be `shallow` or `deep` and defaults to `deep`.
semantic-lensing is reasoning-only; no deterministic tools are required or allowed.
The preferred method reads `_SEMANTIC.md` to understand the matrix structure and question framework.
The preferred method reads production documents under `RuntimeOverrides.DELIVERABLE_PATH`.
If `_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md` exists, the preferred method reads each entry as a candidate improvement.
The preferred method generates proposals with `Lens:` tags grounded in production-document evidence.
Lensing entries must not be treated as evidence.
`_SEMANTIC.md` and `_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md` must not be treated as evidence authority.
semantic-lensing must not invent facts to fill lens-identified gaps; unresolved content uses `TBD`.
semantic-lensing must not widen scope beyond the single deliverable.
`_SEMANTIC.md` must never be edited.
semantic-lensing outputs `PROPOSAL:` blocks with `Lens: <Matrix.Row.Column>` tags.
semantic-lensing outputs `MISSING:` items where lens-identified content gaps exist.
semantic-lensing outputs `NEEDS_HUMAN_RULING:` items where lensing surfaces contradictions.
`_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md` may be updated only when `AllowLensLogUpdate` is true.
`_TRANSFERABLE_CONTEXT.md` may be updated only when `AllowTransferableContextUpdate` is true.
`MEMORY.md` may be updated only when explicitly authorized by the brief.
Matrices in `_SEMANTIC.md` are a tagging and analysis convention, not a completion requirement.
Matrices are used to identify what questions the deliverable should answer.
Matrix coordinates tag proposals so findings remain traceable to the analysis framework.
semantic-lensing does not require every matrix cell to produce a finding.
semantic-lensing must not invent content to fill matrix gaps; gaps use `TBD`.
Each `_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md` row is a candidate improvement with an item type.
The enrichment workflow first reads the entry and identifies target document sections.
The enrichment workflow then reads the target sections in production documents.
If an entry is supported by sources or production documents, generate a `PROPOSAL:` with the lens tag, evidence, and proposed change.
If an entry identifies a real gap, generate a `PROPOSAL:` with `TBD` content and the lens tag.
If an entry conflicts with source material, add it to `NEEDS_HUMAN_RULING`.
If an entry cannot be grounded, convert it to `TBD` or discard it with a note.
`Conflict` items surface both contenders and must not be resolved silently.
`WeakStatement` items propose strengthening with source evidence or mark `TBD`.
`Normalization` items propose terminology or format alignment across documents.
`MissingSlot` items propose content grounded in source evidence or mark `TBD`.
`RationaleGap` items propose rationale from source guidance or mark `TBD`.
`VerificationGap` items propose verification approaches tied to requirements.
`TBD_Question` items attempt resolution from accessible sources and remain `TBD` if unresolved.
Every proposal must cite evidence from production documents or accessible sources.
Lens tags must use the `Matrix.Row.Column` format.
Unknowns remain `TBD` in semantic-lensing work.
Conflicts must be surfaced rather than reconciled silently.
Proposals that incorporate lensing entries must cite the underlying source rather than the lensing entry itself.
Processed `_SEMANTIC_LENSING.md` entries must be noted as incorporated, converted to TBD, or discarded with reason.
The semantic-lensing tool policy is reasoning-first and has no deterministic tool ordering.
No TASK-enforced deterministic tools are available for semantic-lensing.
No operational helper tools are declared for semantic-lensing.
All semantic-lensing phases are reasoning-driven across matrix reading, production-document reading, lensing-entry reading, and proposal generation.
Hidden reliance on undeclared tools is disallowed unless the human expands AllowedTools.
Writes are limited to the effective bounded task brief authorization for the single deliverable under `RuntimeOverrides.DELIVERABLE_PATH`.
